title: Normative edition and profile lock
impact: Latest NAESB retail publication is 4.1 (2026-05-15); full REQ.21 and authoritative new schemas are gated. Mirror 4.1 customer says Published Pending and root version 4.0. Unverified normative differences cannot be called complete.
source: NAESB retail index; public ESPI landing; mirror headers
criteria: Review legally obtained full MBPs and exact dated XSDs; record SHA256, minor corrections and third-party PICS; no purchases/signing in this task.

title: Typed quantity and unit gate
impact: Browser labels every nonnegative IntervalReading as kWh; ignores uom, commodity, kind, accumulationBehaviour and flowDirection. Python instead assumes W and integrates guessed/default duration. Arbitrary power/reactive/register/gas/water may silently be billed as electricity.
criteria: For each enum combination accept dimensional conversion only with documented semantics: Wh energy versus W average power times own duration; demand stays power; var/varh/VA/VAh stay distinct; gas/water/temperature never kWh or OEB rates. Registers need deltas/reset/rollover rules; reverse/export/net remain separate, not clamped consumption. Explicit diagnostics for all unhandled combinations, missing metadata, extreme multiplier, unsafe integers and lexical junk.

title: Atom identities and graph
impact: Regex href suffix matching is not ID/self/up/related graph resolution. Same suffix under two origins collides; MeterReading-only ReadingType links can lose per-channel scale; namespace stripping can interpret foreign elements.
criteria: Index canonical self URIs and atom IDs; respect xml:base and link relation; join UsagePoint→MeterReading→ReadingType→IntervalBlock independent of order; diagnose missing/duplicate/conflicting refs and same suffix different authorities. Keep data provenance; never fetch arbitrary imported links; any CMD fetch must be consented, origin-allowlisted and SSRF-safe.

title: Durations and per-meter clocks
impact: DataPoint drops duration; inferred cadence is not interval occupancy. Browser ignores ReadingType.intervalLength and IntervalBlock.interval. Single LocalTimeParameters selected document-wide.
criteria: Own timePeriod duration wins; ReadingType intervalLength fallback with explicit provenance; block.interval describes block extent NOT a per-reading duration fallback. Retain UTC start/end, split billing/rate boundaries by interval overlap; missing/gap/duplicate/overlap/mixed-cadence incomplete windows stay incomplete. Resolve clocks per meter and test 23/25-hour days, fixed offset and southern-hemisphere rules; no guessing from browser zone.

title: Quality, accumulation and channel qualifiers
impact: ReadingQuality/defaultQuality, consumptionTier, tou, cpp, phase, dataQualifier and timeAttribute discarded; estimated or cumulative values look measured and independent.
criteria: Preserve quality code including unknown values; distinguish measured/estimated/substituted with schema-backed policies; never remove quality silently. Preserve tariff/phase/channel qualifiers to prevent double counting parallel register/TOU streams; each accumulation kind either typed implementation with tests or diagnostic.

title: Complete summaries and itemisation
impact: Both summary names parse subset; demands/current/previous-day/current-period consumption, statusTimeStamp, quality, commodity, tariffProfile/readCycle/riders/source missing. LineItem rounding/dateTime/itemPeriod omitted; measurement timestamp omitted.
criteria: Preserve every field with units/currency/raw scale; fees/negative credits/unknown notes retained without speculative itemKind meaning. Never infer utility-language patterns from synthetics. No cross-meter/cross-currency merging; unknown currency label is unknown, no currency conversion. Deprecated ElectricPowerUsageSummary remains explicit compatibility path. Non-electric summaries cannot enter Ontario tariff model.

title: Power quality and auxiliary typed resources
impact: ElectricPowerQualitySummary, ServiceStatus, ProgramIdMappings, node refs and auxiliary types ignored.
source: espi.xsd global elements and complex types
criteria: Parse+preserve distinct typed objects (no new dashboard inferred) or return explicit resource diagnostics for each pinned class/field. Power quality remains power-quality units, not kWh; retain measurement protocol/summaryInterval.

title: Unknown extensions and safe reporting
impact: Output retains only groups/summaries/one clock. Unsupported resources/extensions vanish; diagnostics describe lack of readings, not ignored data.
source: RFC4287 foreign markup; espi.xsd Object; parseDiagnostic.ts
criteria: Return known/unknown/unsupported counts and QName-aware diagnostics. Preserve safe opaque foreign fields with size/depth limits client-side, never execute markup/PI/DTD or follow URLs. Redact secrets/PII from exports/logs; unsolicited customer data needs opt-in quarantine/drop diagnostic, NOT blanket preservation.

title: CMD capabilities and least-privilege scope
impact: ApplicationInformation is env-config, not resource ingestion. Scope opaque string; no FB/IntervalDuration/BlockDuration/HistoryLength capability negotiation. Authorization only pointer parsed; Subscription is URI aggregate, not schema entity.
source: GBA function-blocks; pinned FunctionBlock.java; Authorization/ApplicationInformation schema; OAuth RFC6749
criteria: Negotiate only consumed, consented electricity usage capabilities, record granted/requested delta. No automatic PII/gas/water scopes for completeness. Parse authorised/published periods/status/expiry and allowlisted pointers; ApplicationInformation safe metadata only, never store client_secret in client dataset. Third-party scope UI distinct from custodian authorization server.

title: Pagination, batch and async completion
impact: One stream fetch; Atom next ignored; BatchList only URL count/change marker; 202 classified without Location/Retry-After continuation or per-item errors.
source: developer API batch docs; espi.xsd BatchListType/BatchItemInfo; espi.ts
criteria: Bounded same-origin next-page traversal with cycle/count/byte/time limits and exact dedupe; partial page failure stays partial. Validate authorised BatchItemInfo resources/status; robust idempotent notification→GET. Bounded 202 continuation/backoff supports documented completion mechanism; never trust arbitrary notification URL as authenticated fetch destination; no SFTP absent explicit integration decision.

title: Remote revoke, rotation concurrency and transport
impact: Local disconnect deletes token file but does not revoke at custodian. Existing rotation test is serial; full provider concurrency/TLS policy not proved.
source: OAuth RFC6749/RFC7009; GBA certification TLS1.3 note; sync.ts
criteria: Serialize refresh per grant, atomically persist rotated tokens; one-time-token concurrent request/restart tests. Handle revocation notification/status/invalid_grant; remote revocation only with documented consented provider endpoint; local disconnect honest about scope. Verify TLS1.3 capability/policy and certificate checks locally, no claim from generic fetch.

title: Retail customer schema / PII isolation
impact: All customer-namespace classes unsupported, except namespace-erasing parser may mistakenly treat customer LocalTimeParameters/UsagePoint as energy names. Statement bill-image refs unsupported.
source: customer.xsd resources and namespace annotation; GBA FB51–70
criteria: Explicit namespace-aware unsupported diagnostics by default. If a later separately approved service needs PII, minimal opt-in scope, separate typed feed/storage boundary, TTL/delete/export/redaction tests. Test each customer global/complex class, Statement/StatementRef/bill-image reference without network download or PII in logs. Inventory NOT an instruction to collect data.

title: Administration/offline/deprecated interfaces
impact: No dynamic registration/SFTP/offline authorization/admin REST implementation; historic FB labels conflict with current GBA/Java.
source: GBA catalog; pinned legacy connect_function_blocks.md; FunctionBlock.java
criteria: Record third-party receive role versus custodian/authorization-server/admin producer role in PICS. Deprecated/reserved ids diagnostic only; do not request automatically. Out-of-role producer APIs remain N/A; optional receiver transports require explicit PM scope and provider evidence.
